newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Garantia completes Multicanal's IPO in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Garantia completes Multicanal's IPO in Brazil.

text.p: Brazil's Banco de Investimentos Garantia said it has completed the sale of the Brazilian tranche of the global initial public offering for cable television operator Multicanal Participacoes S.A.
The Brazilian tranche totalled 27.7 million preferred shares at a price of $1.40 per stock, worth $39 million, lead manager Garantia said in a statement.

The offer to international markets was led by Merrill Lynch and Morgan Stanley, which were joint global coordinators of the issue of 11.1 million ADRs at a price of $14 per ADR. Each ADR represents 10 preferred shares of Multicanal.
The total global offering raised $194 million, the bank said.

Based in Rio de Janeiro, Multicanal is the largest cable television operator in Brazil, Garantia said. The company owns stakes in 15 cable television operators that serve 13 cities in the country, it added.
